finding.problem: The opt-in classifier converts only partial to diagnostic_only. It leaves pass unchanged, even while removing all targets. If the SEO driver later reports full success, the uploaded receipt and scripts/record-stabilization-evidence.mjs status summary can say pass for an instrumented run.
finding.effect: The no-native-credit promise is not invariant to an ordinary future success-status change.
finding.needed_fix: Classify every successful SEO result status as diagnostic_only while retaining unverified/fail and the original status in a separate diagnostic field if useful; cover partial and pass in a behavior test.

positive_evidence: The change reuses scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs and startup-interval-attribution.mjs rather than adding a second sampler; the commit does not alter resource thresholds, stop logic, or cleanup.

scripts/stabilization-resource-journal.mjs:69-133 permits only timestamps, PIDs, executable basenames, categories, and CPU deltas for the bracket; raw ps rows, command arguments, paths, and page data are absent from that event. The SEO driver targets public pages only in this guest path.

Fresh node --test scripts/hosted-seo-route.test.mjs scripts/test-startup-interval-attribution.mjs scripts/test-stabilization-resource-journal.mjs passed 21/21. A separate direct classifier probe confirmed partial becomes diagnostic_only with zero targets and unverified/fail preserve their error statuses with zero targets.

causal_limit_finding.problem: The decision rule suggests a dominant ps delta could select census overhead, but processTimeBracket intersects PIDs present in both snapshots. Its own short-lived before/after ps calls are outside that intersection and cannot quantify their own CPU use; the recorded 25/30 ms times are wall time only.
causal_limit_finding.effect: The proposed run can compare surviving owned and host processes around each iostat sample, but cannot attribute diagnostic self-overhead or infer a single product culprit from an unmatched/unsafe sample.
causal_limit_finding.needed_fix: State this limitation in the decision rule and keep measurement overhead inconclusive unless independently measured.

verdict_b.privacy_limit: No private/raw browser data was found in the new guard event. Existing native screenshots and the complete SEO driver receipt remain separate uploaded artifacts and were not produced by the earlier stopped run.

open_items: Fix pass-to-diagnostic-only classification before dispatching an opted-in run for a no-credit guarantee.
